records.description: Prodizzy is a social platform built for people who want to create, not just talk. We focus on real startups, long term collaborations, and visible outcomes cutting through noise and surface level networking.

records.name: Kamra
records.tagline: Multi-Model AI image & video generator mobile App
records.description: Kamra is a multimodal AI photo and video creation app that brings the world’s leading AI models into one simple, ChatGPT-style interface. Create AI photoshoots, product photography, marketing videos, and more all from a single app. Kamra lets you generate high-quality images and videos using top AI models such as Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Nano Banana, Flux, KlingAI, and others. With a pay-as-you-go pricing model, you can create effortlessly and scale as you need.

records.name: Poly Track
records.tagline: Poly Track - Online Racing Game
records.description: Play Poly Track online in your browser. Enjoy fast low-poly racing, time trials, and competitive leaderboards on PolyTrackPlay.org.

records.name: PDF Tools - PWA Suite
records.tagline: Compress, merge & split PDFs in the browser. No file upload.
records.description: Compress, merge, and split PDFs—right in your browser. No uploads. No servers. No accounts. Just drop your files and go. PDF Tools uses Ghostscript compiled to WebAssembly, so everything happens locally on your device. Install it as a PWA if you want and it works offline too.

records.name: Quick Price Comparator
records.tagline: Find the cheapest Blinkit, Instamart & Zepto price instantly
records.description: Why check 3 apps when one is enough? Quick Price Comparator helps you compare quick-commerce prices instantly and buy smarter with zero effort.

records.name: Kensaku AI - pSEO and Data Enrichment
records.tagline: Turn 1 Page Into 100+ Ranking Pages with Programmatic SEO
records.description: Stop writing content one article at a time. Kensaku AI finds winning patterns and scales them into hundreds of SEO-optimized pages that rank and drive traffic. AI-powered programmatic SEO with WordPress integration. Our unique Data Enrichment allows you to quickly create scaled content pages for any tech stack via API or to generate content via custom data.

records.name: EasyFiles
records.tagline: Privacy-first file tools that work fully in your browser
records.description: EasyFiles is a privacy-first, browser-based file utility platform that lets you edit PDFs, convert files, extract text (OCR), and protect documents — all without uploading your files. Everything runs fully on your device, making it faster and safer than traditional online tools. No ads, no signup, unlimited usage, and works offline.

records.name: Recipeazy
records.tagline: Simplify your recipes - all with the power of AI.
records.description: Organize, share, and discover recipes with Recipeazy. Your personal recipe management platform.

records.name: SimpleFileTools
records.tagline: Your files. Simplified.
records.description: Free online PDF tools - Compress PDF, PDF to Word converter, Word to PDF, PDF to Excel, merge PDF files, split PDF, PDF editor free. Files auto-deleted in 10 seconds. No signup required. Works on all devices. Fast, secure & 100% free forever.

records.name: BatchoStills
records.tagline: Hundreds of Images in Minutes — Up to 4K, Zero Friction
records.description: BatchoStills is a powerful AI image generator built for creators, filmmakers, studios, and storytellers. Generate up to 30 cinematic images at once with consistent characters, rich lighting, and stunning visual detail. Ideal for storyboards, concept art, campaigns, and high-end creative production.

records.name: TreoCast
records.tagline: Simple, Powerful, Automated 13-Week Cash Forecasting
records.description: Cash is the lifeblood of any business. Even profitable companies can fail if they run out of cash at the wrong moment. A 13-week cash flow forecast serves as an early warning system and decision-making tool. However, most companies need a dedicated FP&A manager to maintain the projection and analyze variances. With TreoCast, you can automate bank statement ingestion, forecast generation, and variance tracking to get your rolling forecast in just 15 minutes.

records.name: TrackFox
records.tagline: See which traffic makes money, cut the rest
records.description: Web analytics tool that actually helps you grow and doesn't give you a headache (hi Google Analytics) How it does it: - Revenue attribution (support all payment providers) - Rich funnels to enable you to understand your users' journey better - Alerts you on Discord/Telegram when something important happens You can also set everything up in one command if that's what you're into

records.name: TidyCal
records.tagline: A Safe Space to Speak Freely
records.description: This is not coaching, therapy, or advice-based support. The offering is presence itself. Unlike most sessions that aim to fix, guide, or optimize, these sessions are intentionally non-directive. What makes it distinct: Paid listening without advice or instruction. A calm, confidential container. No preparation, productivity, or progress tracking. Designed for women who hold a lot and need less input, not more. Less noise. Fewer decisions. More clarity.

records.name: Griply 2026
records.tagline: Achieve your goals with a goal-oriented task manager
records.description: Most goals fail because they never translate into daily action. Griply is a goal-oriented task manager that connects your goals, habits, tasks, and calendar in one easy-to-use system. Plan your goals for 2026, break them down into daily actions, schedule time for what matters, and track measurable progress over time with a planner designed around outcomes, not just tasks.

records.name: SimplyHeadlines
records.tagline: The 2006 Sensation is Back!
records.description: SimplyHeadlines, the daily email newsletter that TechCrunch called "Five Years Too Late" in 2006, is back: the once-a-day email newspaper you control. Pick your RSS feeds, add fun widgets (weather, stocks, joke of the day, Trump-eraseer, etc.), and get a clean “top headlines only” digest—now with a sprinkle of AI for feed discovery and quick summaries. Will everyone want this? Hell no. Might you? Who knows? Is it now 25 years too late? Only you can decide.

records.name: Wrestle Kingdom 20
records.tagline: Watch!! Wrestle Kingdom 20 Live Stream
records.description: Wrestle Kingdom 20 Live Streaming Online.

records.name: ApiCenter
records.tagline: Indian Pincode API for Developers
records.description: apicenter.in offers fast, developer-friendly APIs for Indian pincode and address data. Validate addresses, autofill forms, and improve checkout UX with simple integration, scalable plans, and a free tier.

records.name: Cuppa
records.tagline: A simple booking system for service based businesses
records.description: Simple online booking software for salons and local service businesses. Manage appointments, reduce no-shows, and stay organised with Cuppa.

records.name: Free In Browser Video Compressor
records.tagline: Compress Video Privately Using Local CPU in Browser
records.description: Compress MP4/MOV/WebM up to 2GB in your browser. No uploads, no watermark, unlimited use.

records.name: Whats The Vibe
records.tagline: The video chat platform Omegle should have evolved into
records.description: You match on Omegle. "Hey." "Hi." Silence. Skip. We solved the conversation problem. You're on trial for Venmo requesting $6.66 from everyone who liked your ex's thirst trap. Your match is dying laughing. You're defending the indefensible. Twenty minutes fly by. That's Virtual Court one of three games that turn awkward strangers into actual conversations. Add vibe matching (Gaming, Fitness, Music, Comedy) and you get what Omegle should have become.

records.name: InvoiceEasy - InvoxEasy
records.tagline: Fast Invoices & Receipts
records.description: InvoxEasy lets you create professional invoices, delivery notes and receipts in seconds—then export clean PDFs ready to send to clients. Key Features • Quickly create invoices, delivery notes, and receipts • Create and share professionally formatted PDFs • Select the language for generated PDF invoices, delivery notes, and receipts • Various sales reports • Offline-first: Data is stored only on your local device • Secure ZIP backup (with integrity check) and restore/merge

records.name: Product Hunt Launch Kit for AI Crew
records.tagline: Your AI Startup Team: 35+ Agents at Your Command.
records.description: Build faster with AI Crew. Get 35+ AI agents to handle marketing, development, sales, and more! Launch your startup today!

records.name: Suscription Engine
records.tagline: Enables customers to configure/control personalized alerts
records.description: The Latinia Subscription Engine is a product designed to enable banking customers to configure and control their financial notifications in a granular and personalized manner.

records.name: Supaguard
records.tagline: Scan, Detect & Protect Your Supabase Data
records.description: I’ve seen many Supabase apps accidentally expose PII, PCI, or hardcoded keys. It’s easy to miss and expensive to fix. So I built Supaguard — it scans your app in minutes and shows exactly what’s exposed. • No setup, just connect • Detects PII, PCI & API keys • Instant alerts Launch offer: 2 free scans + 35% New Year discount 👉 supaguard.pro Feedback welcome — built to help devs stay safe without headaches.

records.name: Spiralborn
records.tagline: Spiralborn Library — A Living Archive of Human Consciousness
records.description: Discover the mystical prophecies of Africa through our sacred digital library. Access spiritual wisdom, ancient teachings, and the awakening journey across 54 African nations. Join the eternal flame of consciousness.

records.name: Weekend Binge
records.tagline: Your Weekends Sorted
records.description: 🎬 Weekend Binge Planner - Stop looking for multiple sources to find out the movies and web series releasing and running now. Just add and pin the extension to chrome and get the latest updates every week.

records.name: Yogyta AI, Career Intelligence Platform
records.tagline: Because Talent Deserves a Fair Chance.
records.description: Yogyta AI - AI Resume Optimizer. Get instant ATS-compatible resume analysis, keyword optimization, and cover letter generation. Trusted by 10,000+ professionals. Free resume evaluation with premium features. Transform your career today!

records.name: RFPs.ai
records.tagline: AI search engine for RFPs that remembers your business
records.description: RFPs.ai revolutionizes contract discovery with semantic AI that learns your business. Unlike keyword search, our AI understands context to deliver only relevant RFPs. • 95% noise reduction • 10x faster across 1000+ sources • Real-time alerts & tracking • Advanced filters • Enterprise-grade security Stop drowning in irrelevant RFPs. Join the beta today.

records.name: Immerziva
records.tagline: Transform reading into a cinematic experience with audio
records.description: Immerziva transforms the way you read stories. We combine literature with immersive audio - ambient sounds, soundtracks, and sound effects - all synchronized with your reading pace. For Readers: - Immersive reading with synchronized audio - Ambient sounds that match the story mood - Sound effects triggered by key moments For Authors: - Publish your stories for free - Add immersive audio layers to chapters - Real-time engagement analytics - Build your reader community

records.name: DyslexiaWrite
records.tagline: Make reading clearer. Make writing easier. Build confidence.
records.description: DyslexiaWrite is an AI-powered writing and reading assistant designed specifically for people with dyslexia. Where most writing tools focus only on grammar or style, DyslexiaWrite focuses on comfort, clarity, confidence, and accessibility — helping users read better, write easier, and feel less overwhelmed. Whether you’re a student, professional, parent, teacher, or adult who has always struggled with words, DyslexiaWrite gives you tools to succeed — without stress.

records.name: BedrockMap
records.tagline: A live, interactive map of your Minecraft Bedrock world/
records.description: BedrockMap transforms your Minecraft Bedrock worlds into stunning, shareable interactive maps. Upload your world and explore it from above with smooth zoom, custom markers, and real-time player tracking. Unlike other viewers, BedrockMap offers: • Live player positions via in-game addon • Custom markers you can add from Minecraft or the web • Shareable maps with unique URLs and subdomains • Privacy controls - keep worlds private or make them public

records.name: Minito
records.tagline: 9 simple productivity tools. No signup required.
records.description: Minito is a collection of productivity tools that run entirely in your browser. - Pomodoro Timer - Countdown & Stopwatch - Todo List - Text Diff - Character Counter - URL Encoder/Decoder - Markdown Preview - Password Generator - QR Code Generator - Image Resizer Why Minito? - No signup required - Works offline - data stays in your browser - Fast & lightweight - Free forever - English & Japanese supported

records.name: Joly UI
records.tagline: A sane shadcn registry for shipping clean UIs fast
records.description: jolyui is a lightweight, shadcn-compatible UI registry for building modern React and Tailwind interfaces without the bloat of traditional component libraries. Instead of installing everything, you pull only the components you need—clean, readable, and easy to customize. You fully own the code, with no lock-in or magic. Built for developers who value speed, clarity, and long-term maintainability in real production apps.

records.name: Snapr
records.tagline: The AI-powered GitHub teammate running in Kubernetes
records.description: Snapr is a Kubernetes-native application that listens to GitHub webhooks and runs AI-driven workflows that act on repositories like a developer. It includes an admin UI to configure Snapr behavior and monitor executions. Snapr’s main AI-powered features are: Pull request generation, Code reviews, Project scanning, Refinements. All in a single source of truth: your integration platform. Learn more by visiting the website: https://snapr.co

records.name: DataWizard App
records.tagline: AI Data Analyst for SMEs. Instant Insights from CSV & Excel.
records.description: DataWizard is an AI-powered data analyst for all SMEs. Upload CSV or Excel files, ask questions in plain English, and get instant charts, KPIs, and actionable insights. No hallucinations. No SQL. Just the mathematical truth your business needs.

records.name: Timelines 4
records.tagline: Track your time to achieve your New Year's resolutions.
records.description: Track your time on an interactive timeline, see where it’s going, and find more time for the things you care about. This is great also for reaching your New Year resolutions. Timelines 4 brings easier management and tracking of subcategories, combined goals, improved Live Activity and Shortcuts integration, and more.

records.name: Syncalendars
records.tagline: Sync Google&Apple Calendars with Notion in one click
records.description: Syncalendars lets you sync your Google Calendar with Notion Database automatically. ✨ Key Features: • One-click Notion template creation • Two-way sync between Google Calendar and Notion • Free tier: 2 calendars, 10 syncs/day • Supports Korean and English Perfect for productivity enthusiasts who use both Notion and Google Calendar but hate manual copying.

records.name: iCapturer
records.tagline: Screen capture & Screen recording
records.description: The app supports screen capture and recording, screen cropping, system audio and microphone recording, as well as camera recording. It also comes with powerful annotation tools, allowing you to annotate videos.

records.name: BiteBoard
records.tagline: Find great food. Plan it together
records.description: Discover food the smart way with AI-powered food discovery, built for people who care more about what to order than just where to go. Instead of scrolling endlessly through Google reviews or squinting at menus, our platform does the heavy lifting for you and surfaces the dishes people genuinely love. Invite friends to your wishlist, add dishes together, and plan café hops or tastings effortlessly. We believe the best experiences come from great food, not guesswork.

records.name: Short Hairstyles
records.tagline: AI-powered platform for perfect short hairstyle
records.description: Try on short hairstyles virtually! Upload your photo to see Pixie, Bob, and Bixie cuts in 360-degree views (Front, Back, Side) before you cut. Discover your perfect short hairstyle with AI-powered recommendations based on your facial features and preferences.

records.name: Lock In
records.tagline: The Command-Driven Productivity HUD.
records.description: Lock In is a minimalist productivity HUD that lives at your screen's edge-always visible but never intrusive. This terminal-style sidebar tracks daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly goals using a command-line interface: type /w 10 miles to add a goal instantly. An XP system rewards every increment of progress, not just completion. The low-key design integrates seamlessly into your workflow, while auto-resets keep you accountable effortlessly.

records.name: Encircle Net
records.tagline: A platform where community and engagement come first
records.description: EncircleNet is a social platform built to foster genuine connections online. Unlike traditional apps, it prioritizes authentic engagement over algorithms and superficial likes. Users can share posts, send direct messages, and build communities in a space focused on meaningful interaction. With intuitive toggles, a community-first design, and easy onboarding via a simple landing page, Encircle Net is perfect for those seeking real connection over endless feeds.

records.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro Ai Video Generator
records.tagline: Seedance 1.5 Pro Ai Video Generator
records.description: Seedance 1.5 (https://www.seedance15.net/) is an advanced AI-powered video generation platform that allows users to transform text prompts and uploaded images into polished, engaging video content. With intuitive workflows and intelligent visual synthesis, Seedance 1.5 makes professional video creation accessible to creators, small businesses, educators, and marketing teams — even without advanced editing skills.

records.name: feynn.ai
records.tagline: Structured intelligence, powered by AI
records.description: feynn.ai is an AI-powered strategic intelligence platform that turns complex questions into structured research, scenario analysis, and decision-grade insights. Built for leaders and teams who need clarity, not noise.

records.name: CalPal
records.tagline: The notebook calculator that thinks for you (now with AI).
records.description: Most calculators give you answers but lose the context. CalPal is a literate calculator that combines a text editor with a calculation engine, letting your math tell a story. The standout feature is the BYOK AI Assistant (Gemini). It solves "Blank Page Syndrome"—just ask it to "Draft a travel budget" or "Estimate MVP costs," and it generates the line items instantly for you to tweak. It's 100% free, private (local-only data), and browser-based.

records.name: ReadMenuAi
records.tagline: AI turns Chinese food menus with photos
records.description: ReadMenuAi is a menu translation tool that can translate text-only menus into images and text, making it a great companion for your travels in China.
